Estas son las referencias generales de la unidad. Cada página tiene, además, sus propias referencias y libros recomendados.

- Anderson, D. R. (2013). *Modern business statistics with Microsoft Excel* (5.ª ed.). Cengage Learning.
- Fisher, R. A. (1959). *Statistical methods and scientific inference*. Oliver and Boyd.
- Hill, A. B. (1965). The environment and disease: Association or causation? *Proceedings of the Royal Society of Medicine, 58*(5), 295–300. [https://doi.org/10.1177/003591576505800503](https://doi.org/10.1177/003591576505800503)
- Ismay, C., Kim, A. Y. y Valdivia, A. (2025). *Statistical inference via data science* (2.ª ed.). [https://moderndive.com/](https://moderndive.com/)
- Kolmogorov, A. N. (1933). *Foundations of the theory of probability*. Chelsea Publishing Company.
- Rubin, D. B. (1976). Inference and missing data. *Biometrika, 63*(3), 581–592. [https://doi.org/10.1093/biomet/63.3.581](https://doi.org/10.1093/biomet/63.3.581)
- Scheaffer, R. L., Mendenhall, W., & Ott, L. (2006). *Elementos de muestreo*. Paraninfo.
- Walpole, R. E. (2012). *Probability and statistics for engineers and scientists* (9.ª ed.). Pearson Education.
- Wickham, H., Çetinkaya-Rundel, M. y Grolemund, G. (2023). *R for data science* (2.ª ed.). O'Reilly Media. [https://r4ds.hadley.nz/](https://r4ds.hadley.nz/)
- Xie, Y. (s.f.). *bookdown: Authoring books and technical documents with R Markdown*. Recuperado de [https://bookdown.org/yihui/bookdown/](https://bookdown.org/yihui/bookdown/)
